notes: Paths are relative to the project folder. Set voiceover / music to a file path to enable them; null disables them.
A configured file that does not exist stops the build (use --allow-missing to skip it with a warning instead).
Cue 'preset' = built-in sound synthesised by tools/make-sfx.mjs (whoosh, impact, riser, tick). Cue 'file' = your own audio file.
Cue times are scene seconds. gain_db is applied to the cue before mixing.
Cues below match demo-studio.html: camera travels 4-6 s, 9.5-11 s, 17-19 s, 24-26 s; letters land from 6.4 s; city grows from 11 s; brain reveals at 19.5 s; ending at 26.3 s.
